Of its unclaimed prize money, about three-quarters is in wins under $500 and the rest is in bigger prizes. Neither kind is better, and each suits different players.

The numbers for "EMERALD MINE 9X" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
5055.headline: Where the prize money is

5057.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "EASY MONEY", about a quarter are still unsold. The game is in the second half of its run, with three of eight top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Every line of EASY MONEY's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
5057.headline: How far along this game is

5059.body:
"THE CASH WHEEL" has had no $1 million top prize claimed since we started watching it. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

The table below shows the full count for "THE CASH WHEEL", with every prize level included.
5059.headline: Top prizes have lasted so far

5060.body:
Most of the tickets for "FIND THE 7S" have been sold. The game is in the last part of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, a smaller share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a reason to be careful.

If you play "FIND THE 7S" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
5060.headline: Where this game is in its run

5063.body:
The top prize count on "CA$H IN HAND" has not moved for three weeks. The game still has two of four top prizes unclaimed. Smaller prizes keep getting claimed as tickets sell. The same top prizes are now among fewer tickets.

If you play "CA$H IN HAND" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
5063.headline: Top prizes are still unclaimed
